title: Pointless Format Macros (Trivial Formatting)
pattern: Invoking string formatting macros (`format!`) without any arguments or variable interpolation.
why_bad: Executes complex formatting machinery and performs dynamic heap allocations at runtime for a value that is already static and constant.
detection: An invocation of `format!` containing only a single literal string with no replacement placeholders (`{}`).
counterexample: Converting a static string literal to a dynamic heap-allocated `String` (though `.to_string()` is preferred).
fix: Replace the macro call with `.to_string()` on the literal or direct assignment.
